Use of clomifene during early pregnancy and risk of hypospadias: population based case-control study. Clomifene is widely used for inducing ovulation.1 It is structurally related to diethylstilbestrol, which has been linked to vaginal and cervical clear cell adenocarcinoma in women exposed in utero.
